Container.Name: BookshelfNG
Container.Overview: Legacy BookshelfNG template. Applying its update installs ChaptarrNG and converts a supported BookshelfNG database on startup.
Container.Description: BookshelfNG has been superseded by ChaptarrNG. This legacy template keeps the existing /config, /data, /download, host port 8787, PUID, PGID, and TZ settings while switching to the standard ChaptarrNG image. Back up the complete appdata directory before applying the update. Automatic database conversion currently supports only the BookshelfNG migration-158 SQLite schema; unsupported databases fail closed. New installations should use the ChaptarrNG Community Applications entry. SeerrNG remains optional. Hardcover environment settings are preserved for ChaptarrNG.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: bookshelfng bookshelf readarr hardcover ebook audiobook seerrng
Container.Changes: Transition template: apply the regular ChaptarrNG release to the existing BookshelfNG data directory. Keep an independent appdata backup until conversion and validation finish.
Container.Requires: Docker and persistent appdata. Stop BookshelfNG before applying this update. New installations should use the ChaptarrNG template.
